summary: Remote-controlled agent daemon accepts PTY/SSH-tunnel commands from a hardcoded gateway
details: The @whalent/agent daemon (started via the `whalent` bin) opens an outbound WebSocket to a hardcoded gateway at wss://memory.whalent.com/gw/sdk/ws and accepts remote commands from that server. Bundled dependencies include node-pty, @xterm/headless, ssh2, proxy-agent, and socks-proxy-agent. Strings in dist/core.cjs expose gateway message handlers including `ssh.tunnel.open`, `proxy.open`, and `preview.open`, along with loopback references to 127.0.0.1:3389 (RDP) and 127.0.0.1:5900/5901 (VNC), consistent with a reverse-tunnel/remote-desktop bridging surface on the installer host. The shipped bundles (dist/index.cjs ~48KB and dist/core.cjs ~4.8MB) are processed by javascript-obfuscator (rotated string arrays, `_0xNNNN` identifiers, control-flow flattening), materially impeding independent verification of the command handlers. The gateway holds control of an interactive PTY and SSH/proxy tunnels on the host running the daemon; blast radius is full-host RCE mediated by the vendor's gateway.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
